messages.text:
The app itself exposes the correct accessible controls: prompt preview is the `Open The Cold-Email Closer` button, not the heading text.

I’m correcting the browser smoke to use those controls and making the drawer assertion mobile-only so it doesn’t test hidden mobile UI on desktop.
